creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Seen 2026-11-02 once in a full gate on the Mac mini at load 17 to 31 (other agents' builds), on branch reopen-closed-pane, whose change does not touch muster-ssh, and it passed run alone straight after. It failed at crates/muster-ssh/tests/fake_ssh/left_behind.rs:31 with "the master of a Muster that is gone is still running": the stand-in master for a Muster that had exited was still running 5 seconds after `end_left_behind`.

The deadline is 5 seconds of wall time for a signal and an exit, which a machine with every core busy can exceed. Find what end_left_behind does between finding the master and the stand-in exiting (a process census, a kill, a grace) and whether a step there waits on something load stretches; a longer deadline is the fallback, not the fix.
title: 🎲 A left-behind SSH master can outlive its 5-second deadline under load
